title: Checkpoint: branch inventory
prompt: Implement `String describe(int x)`: "negative" when x < 0; "zero" when x == 0; "single" when x is 1–9 inclusive; "large" when x >= 10. Every branch must be reachable and boundaries exact.

tests.name: branch coverage
tests.hint: Four mutually exclusive bands: test negatives first, then zero, then the range.
